data.title: Recapture: append Vellum + Secret Garden works.json entries

data.body: Reviewed: appended vellum(#11) + secret-garden(#12) to works.json (append-only, 10 existing works untouched). Media: public/lab/vellum.gif (4.9MB, translucent-paper sheets drifting over flower photo w/ Explorer panel), public/lab/secret-garden.gif (1.8MB, 900px, 8s seamless sway loop clearly framing the LIT front of the ivy cottage), + 2 stills in public/lab/shots/. Verified visually (frame extraction), works.json parses, all media resolves, npx tsc --noEmit exit 0. FLAGS: (1) vellum date 2026-06-20 is a PLACEHOLDER - needs Julianna to confirm. (2) secret-garden root-caused: prior 'empty meadow' was because window.__sgReady fires on WS onInit ~immediately but the cottage GLB (draco) loads ~10s later; the built-in ?auto camera already frames the lit cottage perfectly, so fix was just waiting for window.__cottage before recording. No commit/push per guardrails.
